name: Prompt, Reference, Lineage, and Portability
description: How mapped evidence becomes prompt references, generation context, derivative lineage, and portable mapped artifact bundles.

codeEntities.label: DiagramCodeEntityMapRecord
codeEntities.summary: Persists the revision-scoped spatial mappings that connect an ASCII artifact to source-backed CodeEntities.

codeEntities.label: DiagramElementMapping
codeEntities.summary: Identifies one visible ASCII span and the CodeEntity source range represented by that span.

codeEntities.label: referenceFromMapping
codeEntities.summary: Converts a spatial mapping into a provenance-aware reference identity with stable source-range identity.

codeEntities.label: ReferenceIdentity
codeEntities.summary: Carries the kind, target identity, provenance, and optional source-range address of a selected reference.

codeEntities.label: resolveReference
codeEntities.summary: Resolves a persisted reference identity against available evidence and artifact records while checking provenance.

codeEntities.label: GenerationPromptReference
codeEntities.summary: Persists a reference together with the exact prompt representation supplied to the generation agent.

codeEntities.label: createGenerationPromptConfig
codeEntities.summary: Validates selected evidence and references, renders their prompt representations, and builds immutable generation context.

codeEntities.label: GenerationPromptConfigRecord
codeEntities.summary: Persists the rendered system, context, reference, mapping, and derivation inputs for one generation.

codeEntities.label: runGenerationPromptTurns
codeEntities.summary: Executes the initial, optional reference, and mandatory mapping prompt turns while preserving the final artifact.

codeEntities.label: DiagramRecord
codeEntities.summary: Persists a generated or materialized diagram together with its evidence dependencies and derivation lineage.

codeEntities.label: buildDerivativePrompt
codeEntities.summary: Walks artifact and prompt-config lineage to reconstruct prior corrections and historical references for a derivative.

codeEntities.label: MappedArtifactBundle
codeEntities.summary: Defines a portable artifact package containing the artifact, its evidence dependencies, and its optional spatial map.

codeEntities.label: mappedArtifactBundle
codeEntities.summary: Collects an artifact, all of its resolvable evidence dependencies, and its current mapping into a transfer bundle.

codeEntities.label: importArtifact
codeEntities.summary: Validates and persists an imported ASCII artifact and, when supplied, its provenance, evidence, and spatial mapping bundle.

codeEntities.label: ImportedArtifactLibraryRecord
codeEntities.summary: Indexes globally imported diagrams, components, evidence dependencies, and mapped artifact identities.
